notes: All pages require customerId in route context because all authoritative endpoints are customer-scoped.
Detailed log pages are intended for admin/authorized roles only, but auth implementation details are out of scope; frontend should still surface access-denied states when backend rejects access.
No frontend routes are defined for policy authoring/publishing because the API contract omits policy management CRUD.
No ingestion management or archival screens are defined because the API contract does not expose those capabilities.

pages.title: Execution Request Search
pages.purpose: Locate candidate execution requests by time range and basic metadata before drilling into a specific request for audit and troubleshooting.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Search filters: from_ts, to_ts, optional policy_id, optional policy_version, optional channel, optional decision, optional status, optional page_size
Paged request summary items including request_id, correlation_id, policy_id, policy_version, timestamps, duration, outcome, analytics_dimensions, executed_rule_names, rule_execution_count
user_actions: Paginate/load next page when next_page_token is present in response metadata
Open request detail by correlation_id when correlation_id is present
loading_states: Initial empty state before first search
error_states: 400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE shown inline near date filters
Generic API failure banner for network/server errors
Empty results state when items array is empty

pages.title: Search Requests by Executed Rule
pages.purpose: Find request executions where a named rule fired using the denormalized executed_rule_names list on the request record.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Search filters: from_ts, to_ts, required rule_name, optional policy_id, optional policy_version, optional decision, optional page_size
Result items with request summary subset
user_actions: Enter date range and rule name
Open a request detail from results

pages.title: Search Requests by JSON Field Value
pages.purpose: Search request-level executions by a value inside stored request, response, or intermediate JSON content using an allowed dotted JSON path.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Search form: from_ts, to_ts, json_path, value
Results with request_id, correlation_id, policy metadata, timestamps, outcome, request_payload, response_payload, intermediate_summary
user_actions: Enter date range, JSON path, and value
Inspect matching payload snippets in result rows
loading_states: Initial guidance/empty state explaining safe dotted path requirement
Optional lazy expand for large JSON snippets in rows

pages.title: Direct Request Lookup
pages.purpose: Quickly open a single request by request ID or correlation ID when the identifier is already known.
data_requirements: customerId from route
User-entered requestId or correlationId
user_actions: Choose lookup mode: request ID or correlation ID
Navigate to corresponding detail page on success
error_states: 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND as not-found helper state with option to retry another ID

pages.title: Request Drilldown
pages.purpose: Inspect a full request-level execution record together with all ordered rule execution details to understand why an outcome occurred.
data_requirements: customerId and requestId from route

Request drilldown payload including request metadata, full request/response JSON, intermediate summary, outcome, analytics_dimensions, executed_rule_names, rule_execution_count, and rule_execution_trace
user_actions: View request metadata and outcome summary
Expand/collapse request payload, response payload, and intermediate summary JSON viewers
Select a rule trace row to inspect snapshots, variables touched, and any error details
loading_states: Section-level expansion loading only if UI lazily renders large JSON
error_states: Generic API error banner with retry

pages.title: Request Drilldown by Correlation ID
pages.purpose: Inspect a full request and associated rule trace when correlation ID is the available lookup key.
data_requirements: customerId and correlationId from route
Same drilldown payload shape returned by correlation lookup
user_actions: Navigate to canonical request route using returned request_id if desired

pages.title: Rule Execution Variable Search
pages.purpose: Locate individual rule execution events where a named variable had a specific value, supporting deep troubleshooting beyond request-level search.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Filters: from_ts, to_ts, variable_name, variable_value, optional rule_name, optional stage_name, optional execution_result, optional page_size
Result rows with request/correlation IDs, policy metadata, rule_log_seq, rule_name, stage_name, executed_at, execution_result, variables_touched, output_snapshot, error
user_actions: Enter required variable name and variable value plus date range
Inspect matching variable snapshots in results
Open parent request detail for a selected row

pages.title: Custom Extract Builder
pages.purpose: Return a reusable extract for a supplied set of request IDs so implementation and delivery teams can build tailored outputs from authoritative request and rule-log data.
data_requirements: customerId from route
User-supplied array/list of request IDs
Extract response items containing request summary fields, analytics_dimensions, request/response payloads, and compact rule_logs
user_actions: Paste or upload a line-separated list of request IDs into a text area (frontend parsing only)
Review returned extract in tabular/card form
Copy or download client-side JSON of the returned response for downstream use
error_states: 413 TOO_MANY_REQUEST_IDS with guidance to split batches
Empty response state if no matching items returned

pages.title: Policy Version Outcome Comparison
pages.purpose: Compare outcomes across versions of a single policy to identify shifts in approval/rejection patterns, score changes, and latency changes.
data_requirements: customerId and policyId from route
Date range filter
Items per policy_version with total_requests, decision_breakdown, avg_score, avg_duration_ms
user_actions: Switch between chart and table views
error_states: Empty analytics state when no records exist in range

pages.title: Outcome Analysis by Dimension
pages.purpose: Produce report-ready metrics such as approval rates by age band, region, or segment using allowed analytics dimensions.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Filters: dimensionName, from_ts, to_ts, optional policy_id, optional policy_version
Items with dimension_value, total_requests, decision_breakdown including avg_score
user_actions: Choose date range and optional policy filters
Inspect metric rows by dimension bucket
loading_states: Loading skeleton for chart and table
error_states: 400 INVALID_DIMENSION_NAME inline guidance that only backend-allowed dimensions work; frontend cannot infer full allowed list from API contract

pages.title: Policy Rule Impact Analysis
pages.purpose: Show which rules are firing differently across policy versions to help explain business-impact changes beyond top-level outcome rates.
data_requirements: customerId and policyId from route
Date range filter
Items with policy_version, rule_name, total_executions, result_breakdown, avg_rule_duration_ms
user_actions: Sort/filter result table client-side by rule name, policy version, or execution count

pages.title: Retention Management
pages.purpose: Preview purge candidates for a customer and execute a confirmed administrative purge at a selected cutoff timestamp.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Current customer logging config for contextual retention settings
Purge cutoff timestamp entered by user
Preview response listing eligible execution_requests and rule_execution_logs
Purge execution response with deleted counts
user_actions: View current logging enabled state and retention policy
loading_states: Destructive action loading state during purge
error_states: 404 customer config not found shown as contextual warning while still allowing retention actions only if backend permits
400 PURGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED should not occur if frontend sets confirm=true, but show banner if returned

pages.title: Customer Logging Configuration
pages.purpose: View and update customer-level execution logging enablement, deployment mode, retention policy, and authorized log viewer roles.
data_requirements: customerId from route
Config fields: customer_name, deployment_mode, logging_enabled, retention_policy.retention_days, purge_mode, purge_after_field, authorized_log_viewer_roles
user_actions: Edit customer name and deployment mode
Edit retention days, purge mode, purge-after field
error_states: 404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND can be treated as empty/create-new config form
409 CUSTOMER_ID_MISMATCH banner though frontend should avoid mismatch by deriving from route

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to list policies or allowed analytics dimensions.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_impact: Analytics pages requiring policyId or dimensionName must rely on route parameters, free-text input, or externally supplied navigation context rather than an in-app picker backed by this API contract.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No generic full-text or arbitrary nested search endpoint exists beyond JSON path search and variable/value search.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_impact: Search UI must be explicit about supported search modes and should not promise free-form global search.
Any download/export capability must be limited to client-side export of already returned API payloads.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: Pagination continuation is partially specified: responses include next_page_token, but request query params do not define page_token/next_page_token inputs.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_impact: Frontend can render pagination affordances, but end-to-end cursor pagination behavior requires backend clarification before implementation.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to compare arbitrary policy definitions or retrieve policy metadata/history.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_impact: Business-impact analysis is limited to analytics aggregates by supplied policyId and versions present in results; the frontend cannot show actual rule-definition diffs.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for LLM insights.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_impact: Do not design an AI insights screen for this POV despite future roadmap interest.
